tiers.name: fast
tiers.use_for: locate code, search, read and extract, classify, summarize logs or diffs, mechanical edits from an exact spec

tiers.name: standard
tiers.use_for: implement from a spec, write or fix tests, multi-file edits, gather research, review a small diff

tiers.name: deep
tiers.use_for: adversarial review, verification, root-cause debugging, design tradeoffs, synthesis

tiers.name: frontier
tiers.use_for: rare: the hardest long-horizon reasoning or the highest-stakes final judgment

advice.message: A critic's prose is its deliverable: compressed output drops the reasoning behind each finding. Leave caveman out of review, verification and synthesis briefs.
